title: Binance Will Add 币安人生 (币安人生) and zkPass (ZKP) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert & Margin
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  币安人生 (币安人生) and zkPass (ZKP)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert  and  Binance Margin  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn 币安人生 Flexible Products  and  ZKP Flexible Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2026-01-07 14:00 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  币安人生 (币安人生) and zkPass (ZKP)  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay  or buy and sell  币安人生 (币安人生) and zkPass (ZKP)  with their  account balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  币安人生 (币安人生) and zkPass (ZKP)  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading  币安人生 (币安人生) and zkPass (ZKP)  against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of  币安人生 (币安人生) and zkPass (ZKP)  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Cross Margin & Isolated Margin Binance Margin will add  zkPass (ZKP)  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  ZKP/USDT  and  ZKP/USDC  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2026-01-07 14:00:00 (UTC). Portfolio Margin Binance Margin will add  zkPass (ZKP)  as a new borrowable asset on Portfolio Margin, as well as the  ZKP/USDT  and  ZKP/USDC  pairs on Portfolio Margin at  2026-01-07 14:00:00 (UTC). Notes:  Please note that newly listed tokens tend to be volatile; users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies when trading such tokens. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! You may contact Circle using the following contact information: +33(1)59000130 and EEA-Customer-Support@circle.com.  Holders of USDC have a legal claim against Circle SAS as the EU issuer of USDC. These holders are entitled to request redemption of their USDC from Circle SAS. Such redemption will be made at any time and at par value.
